name: Sarroca de Bellera (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with a red ram rampant collared, belled and hoofed in dark blue.
history: The official flag of Sarroca de Bellera is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with the red ram rampant collared, belled and hoofed in dark blue of the arms, 13/16 of the height and 1/4 of the length of the cloth; approved by the Generalitat on 7 June 2016 and published in the DOGC on 20 June 2016.

features.role: collar, bell and hooves of the ram
